answer.explanation: Every UploaderFunction invocation in the window fails at handler.py line 29 with NoSuchBucket on S3.put_object(Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET). The error is consistent rather than intermittent, and NoSuchBucket is a resource-existence error, not an AccessDenied error, so this points to the configured bucket name not matching an existing bucket rather than to a missing IAM permission. The CrudApi, Thumbnailer and Compression functions run normally in the same window. The OUTPUT_BUCKET value is the most likely culprit. The IaC bucket definition is the second candidate, in case the bucket was never created or was removed. I could not verify these artifacts against live configuration or the template, so the ranking is based on the log evidence alone.
